Name: OK Night Check
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
Another mod for anyone who accidentally goes AFK so the game doesn't start the new day without your confirmation.

This also allows you to prevent the game saving if you want to do a day over instead.

I didn't really intend for it to be a literal OK check, but the OK button was all that remained when I gutted the shipping menu and I thought it could be appropriate and kind of funny too. I hope you're all okay <3

If you have the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6503]my Quotes mod[/url], you can choose to show a random quote above the OK button.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can edit the config.json file that is created when first running the game or use GMCM.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
